title: Warranty-Holder Discount on Customer-Paid Calibration — Insurance Claim Repairs Customer Terms
content:
A customer whose earlier network calibration work is under warranty takes a discount on the calibration line of a denied-operation addition to an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order — on the calibration line alone, never on labor or any other part of the price. Eligibility is read from the customer's active coverages under Workmanship Warranties.

## Terms

(a) An active **Calibration Workmanship Warranty** issued fewer than **12 months** before today gives the recent-calibration percentage of **10 percent**.

(b) An active Calibration Workmanship Warranty issued **12 months or more** before today, or an active **Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty**, gives the other-warranty percentage of **5 percent**.

(c) Any other customer takes no discount.

Months are whole calendar months from the issued date to today. Term (a) is read first: a customer meeting it takes 10 percent even when also holding an active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty.

| Active Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Its age in whole calendar months | Active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Discount on the calibration line |
|---|---|---|---|
| held | fewer than 12 | held or not | 10 percent |
| held | 12 or more | held or not | 5 percent |
| not held | — | held | 5 percent |
| not held | — | not held | none |

## Boundary and amount cases (hypothetical)

- Calibration Workmanship Warranty issued 11 whole calendar months ago: 10 percent. At 12 whole months: 5 percent.
- On a calibration line of USD 260.00, 10 percent is USD 26.00 and 5 percent is USD 13.00.
- A Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty alone is not among the holdings listed: no discount.
